public_requirement: The file hrv_indices.csv exists at the declared output root.

The submission is a valid CSV table with exactly 95 data columns named precisely as listed in 'Required output', each appearing exactly once; column order is free but no column may be missing, duplicated, renamed or extra. Exactly one data row is present with every field either a decimal numeric literal or an explicit empty field. Blank CSV records, quoted or literal NaN/Inf and any non-numeric, non-finite, or binary content fail.

Every time-domain metric value (25 columns HRV_MeanNN..HRV_TINN) matches the reference value within relative tolerance 1e-6 of the reference magnitude plus absolute floor 1e-9. Empty fields must correspond exactly to metrics undefined in the reference (HRV_SDANN2, HRV_SDNNI2, HRV_SDANN5, HRV_SDNNI5): an empty field where the reference is defined, or a number where the reference is undefined, is wrong.

Every frequency-domain metric value (10 columns HRV_ULF..HRV_LnHF) matches the reference value within relative tolerance 1e-6 of the reference magnitude plus absolute floor 1e-9, with NaN-valued cells serialized as an empty HRV_ULF field exactly as in the reference; incorrect emptiness, presence, or magnitude fails.

Every non-linear-domain metric value (60 columns HRV_SD1..HRV_Symbolic_EqualProb4_2UV) matches the reference value within relative tolerance 1e-6 of the reference magnitude plus absolute floor 1e-9; the section must contain no unspecified rows or additional values, and exactly one value is accepted per metric.
